name: hcportal_getLandingPageData
description: Returns landing page data for an authenticated portal user (device-bound auth via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth; any signed-in portal user, no kennel permission gate). After validation it updates the device's FCM token when it has changed and logs a HC.PortalAccess row in one transaction, then returns the user's profile and the kennels the user follows with membership status, kennel details and portal-only derived permissions (edit/design website, manage products) computed with the Permissions V2 effective-grant logic and the SuperAdmin (0x40000000) bypass.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: fcmToken
parameters.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging token for push notifications. If the stored value differs from this, the Device record is updated.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on auth failure (from HC6.ValidatePortalAuth, ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(255)) or from the CATCH block (ERROR_MESSAGE()). Short-circuits; no data rowsets follow.

rowsets.name: UserProfile
rowsets.description: User profile information. Single row returned on success.

columns.name: firstName
columns.description: User's first name. COALESCE to empty string if NULL.

columns.name: lastName
columns.description: User's last name. COALESCE to empty string if NULL.

columns.name: hashName
columns.description: User's hash name. COALESCE to empty string if NULL.

columns.name: displayName
columns.description: User's display name. COALESCE to empty string if NULL.

rowsets.name: KennelList
rowsets.description: List of kennels the user is following (HasherKennelMap.Following = 1). Joins Hasher, HasherKennelMap, Kennel, City, Country, and Region tables.

columns.name: cityName
columns.description: City name from HC.City. Added v1.1.0 to support kennel picker search by city.

columns.name: regionName
columns.description: Region/state/province name from HC.Region (LEFT JOIN — null if kennel city has no region). Added v1.1.0.

columns.name: continentName
columns.description: Continent name from HC.Country. Added v1.1.0 to support kennel picker search by continent (e.g. 'Asia', 'Europe').

columns.name: defaultCurrencySymbol
columns.description: Currency symbol, coalesced from Kennel.CurrencySymbol then Country.CurrencySymbol

columns.name: defaultDigitsAfterDecimal
columns.description: Digits after decimal for currency display, coalesced from Kennel.DigitsAfterDecimal then Country.DigitsAfterDecimal

columns.name: defaultRunStartTime
columns.description: Default run start time (CAST from Kennel.DefaultRunStartTime TIME to DATETIME)

columns.name: defaultRunDayOfWeek
columns.description: Kennel.DefaultRunDayOfWeek (1=Mon .. 7=Sun), COALESCE to 1 when NULL. Column added by db/hc6/portal/archive/add_DefaultRunDayOfWeek_to_Kennel.sql (not in the stale table script).

columns.name: isFollowing
columns.description: Whether user is following the kennel. Always 1 due to WHERE hkm.Following = 1 filter.

columns.name: appAccessFlags
columns.description: App access flags for the user-kennel relationship from HC.HasherKennelMap

columns.name: canEditWebsite
columns.description: 1 if the user holds the SuperAdmin flag (AppAccessFlags & 0x40000000) on this kennel's map row, or any mmRole/appFlag grantor they hold is allowed FunctionKey 'editWebsite' (per-kennel HC.RolePermission override tri-state, else the global default). Mirrors HC6.CheckKennelPermission. Gates the Edit Website button.

columns.name: canDesignWebsite
columns.description: 1 if the user holds the SuperAdmin flag (AppAccessFlags & 0x40000000) on this kennel's map row, or any mmRole/appFlag grantor they hold is allowed FunctionKey 'designWebsite' (per-kennel HC.RolePermission override tri-state, else the global default). Mirrors HC6.CheckKennelPermission. Gates the Design Website button.

columns.name: canManageProducts
columns.description: 1 if the user holds the SuperAdmin flag (AppAccessFlags & 0x40000000) on this kennel's map row, or any mmRole/appFlag grantor they hold is allowed FunctionKey 'manageProducts' (per-kennel HC.RolePermission override tri-state, else the global default). Mirrors HC6.CheckKennelPermission. Gates the Products button; must agree with the HC6.CheckKennelPermission gate in hcportal_getKennelProducts.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Device SET FcmToken = @fcmToken, updatedAt = GETDATE() WHERE id = @deviceId AND FcmToken != @fcmToken (inside the transaction)
INSERT HC.PortalAccess (hasherId) — one row per landing-page load (inside the same transaction)
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning

codeSmells.issue: CATCH block does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 178-181: the CATCH rolls back and returns the envelope but writes no HC.ErrorLog row, so a runtime failure of the landing page leaves no server-side record.

codeSmells.issue: FCM token never set when the stored token is NULL
codeSmells.detail: Line 73: `FcmToken != @fcmToken` is UNKNOWN when Device.FcmToken IS NULL, so a device with no token on file is never given one here. Also a NULL @fcmToken is silently a no-op (fine), but the NULL-stored case is a missed update.

codeSmells.issue: Effective-grant permission logic copied three times inline
codeSmells.detail: Lines 122-166 repeat the HC6.CheckKennelPermission effective-grant EXISTS block for editWebsite, designWebsite and manageProducts. A change to the tri-state rules must be made in four places (here x3 plus the helper) or the UI gate and the SP gate disagree.
